title: Unforgettable Alhambra of Granada and Nasrid Palaces.
text:
Andrés is a magnificent and expert guide. In a simple way, he helped us understand the amazing history of the Alhambra and, above all, to appreciate it.  I also feel grateful for his support, for his excellent tourist recommendations, and for having taken nice photographs of my daughter and me. I hope the company recognizes his work favorably.
On the other hand, it was unfortunate that there were no restrooms at the Top Tour reception office (MNPQ Gestores Turísticos SL). They recommended I go to a nearby coffee shop where I had to make a purchase to use the facility.

title: Beautiful place to visit
text: Beautiful place to visit, waiting time a little long to get in. We had booked a specific time to get in but where told that our time slot to enter Nastrid place was not the same time as ticket. A little frustrating as it was never mentioned upon reservation.
author: anncL1406EF

title: ID required on entry
text: The experience started badly as we were not aware that ID had to be shown and my wife had left her passport at the hotel. The staff were a little aggressive but eventually we were given help and our hotel kindly forwarded passport details.  After a 40 minute wait we managed to gain access. The site was very interesting and some of the buildings unlike anything I've seen before. The crowds were not too bad either. The audio guide gave some facts but it would have been more interesting to find out about the lives of people living there. Also signage at each area would have helped in understandin
author: N8973NXmikem

title: Nathalia, our excellent English guide! Thank you!
text: Aside from the overcrowded Alhambra, which does no one any favors with 10,000 people passing through, Nathalia was very attentive, guided us wonderfully, and always made sure we stayed together. She speaks very understandable English, not too quickly, and knew a lot about history to share. She was able to answer advanced questions very well. A friendly and educational event! Nevertheless, those in charge should allow fewer people at the same time!
author: Maike A
